scope: employee-portal dynamic expressions plus explicitly separated shared imports
workingTreeContext: Read-only classification of current working tree including uncommitted portal audit fixes.
method: Each of the 65 unresolved original router arguments was inspected through source, known caller/catalog and parameter generation. Route patterns were matched against existing app route files. Generic overrides, unconstrained input strings, database record validity, session/authorization and workflow execution are not inferred from file existence.

statusDefinitions.static_resolved: Bounded employee/shared route patterns are derived from code and have existing route files; no runtime navigation guarantee.
statusDefinitions.partial_static_resolved: Known default/employee subset is statically resolved; generic input or override destinations remain open.
statusDefinitions.open_dynamic: Unbounded caller/prop/path destination; no complete finite resolution.
statusDefinitions.other_context_static_resolved: Finite non-employee destinations have existing route files; kept separate from employee coverage.
statusDefinitions.other_context_open: Non-employee/shared generic branch identified, but all destinations/query workflows are not certified.
statusDefinitions.missing_employee_target: Concrete reachable employee destination without a matching app route file.

priorTestSourceReferences.covers: own/team/calendar-prefixed route generation and detail scope

limitations: Static route matches are not authenticated end-to-end checks.
Sample substitutions check route patterns only, not arbitrary live IDs.
Query parameter construction is recorded; runtime support is not inferred solely from the route file.
Native/web visual or touch usability is outside this read-only classification.
